examples: Clean an article copied from a website before pasting into a document.

faq.a: No. Tag removal runs entirely in your browser. Nothing is sent to a server.

faq.q: Does it handle nested or malformed HTML?
faq.a: Yes. It uses a simple DOM-based approach that extracts text content reliably for most HTML.

faq.q: Will scripts or styles be included?
faq.a: No. Only visible text content is kept; script and style blocks are ignored.
